The error that you are seeing on the third page of your powerpoint ("Failed attempting to extract the tool from MSstats_external_3.3.11.1 Value cannot be null") might be caused by you having a report with a blank name in Skyline.

That is, in Skyline, if you go to:
File > Export > Report
I think that you will see a report in the list there that has a blank name.  You can use the "Edit List" button to rename the report.

If that is the case, it would be helpful if you could remember how your report got a blank name. Skyline is not supposed to let you give a report a blank name, and I would like to fix the bug that allowed you to do so.

It looks like you are experiencing more errors than this. I would recommend uninstalling and installing Skyline again. This page has information about how to uninstall Skyline if anything goes wrong:
https://skyline.gs.washington.edu/labkey/wiki/home/software/Skyline/page.view?name=tip_recover_install

On the last page of your PowerPoint, it looks like you are running into some problems installing R packages, but the text of the error messages in the Immediate Window has been cut off, so I cannot tell what is going wrong.
